found_at: https://app.voucherify.io/ (main-EP53XYDN.js: `var Vst="/images/logo/voucherify_logo--primary.svg"`; the same bundle sets the brand colour `color:"#163ed4"`)
edits: removed the "voucherify" wordmark paths (elements 0-10), keeping the % mark (elements 11-13)
cropped the viewBox to the mark with 2% padding
#001254 -> #FFFFFF on the whole % (navy vanishes on the dark tile); white is Voucherify's own dark-background colour (docs dark logo voucherify_logo_white.png, app voucherify_logo_white.png)
notes: DECISION: Voucherify's most recognisable form is its app icon, a #163ED4 blue tile with a white %, but it exists only as PNG (website favicon, docs favicon, app favicon.png; no SVG in its site, docs, app bundle or GitHub org). The only coloured official SVG is the app's primary logo in navy #001254, used here for light mode; that navy vanishes on the dark tile and Voucherify has no coloured dark-background version, so dark mode is the white % (rule 2c). Navy reads close to black on a white tile. If Dhruv wants the blue look, the only route is an official SVG of the blue tile, which Voucherify does not publish.
license: Voucherify brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Voucherify.
